build_imdb_for_visdial: build an IMDB JSON file from VisDial dataset JSONs and COCO image features
run_imdb_builder_cli: run the IMDBBuilder CLI to build a VisDial IMDB with custom output path and dataset split
create_id_to_path_mapping: create a mapping from image IDs to .npy feature file paths in the COCO directory
tokenize_visdial_sentences: tokenize VisDial questions, answers, and captions using the MMF tokenize utility
parse_dialogs_with_features: parse VisDial dialogs by attaching image feature paths and tokenized captions to each dialog
